**REVERSE JING-JING（逆晶晶體）**: a kinetic lyric film. 1920×1080 · 30 fps · H.264 + AAC 256k · 3:46

作者 · Song by **[Benson Hung](https://www.youtube.com/@hbshun)**

Every word and every 中文 character is timed to its vocal attack in the waveform, using Demucs vocal separation, Whisper, and onset/syllable snapping. The backgrounds are driven by the song's actual spectrum and waveform. English glides in, 中文 stamps down, and REVERSE mirrors. The shot-by-shot design is in [STORYBOARD.md](../STORYBOARD.md).

Rendered deterministically in CI from this tag (`./build.sh assets/song.mp3`).
